purpose: Drop-in interface for the cinematic interlude (#cinematic) in index.html. Place rights-cleared source images here with these exact filenames and they appear automatically. If a file is absent, the section falls back to the journal gradient + cover-art.svg, so the layout never breaks.
note: A filename listed here is a slot, not proof the binary was uploaded. Image import/curation is handled separately (GPT / Canva / Lovable); this folder is only the interface. One quality master per image, no duplicates, no private data.

slots.recommended: landscape, >=1920px wide, calm area for centered text

slots.role: scene 3 background — finale with Israel-flag reveal
